What made the difference in AIR 46 Shambhavi Tiwari’s UPSC Mains preparation?

In this conversation with Santosh Sir, Director at LevelUp IAS, Shambhavi shares her UPSC journey and her experience with LevelUp IAS, including the Mains Master Program (MMP) and Anthropology preparation.

She talks about how LevelUp IAS helped her stay honest and consistent with her preparation, and how MMP contributed to improving her UPSC Mains preparation and answer writing.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 and looking for a structured approach to UPSC Mains, GS preparation, answer writing, revision, testing and exam-oriented preparation, this conversation offers an insight into the experience of an AIR 46.

Watch the video to hear directly from AIR 46 about her Mains preparation and LevelUp IAS MMP experience.
